item4_first_plan_proposal.text:
## Reality checks
```yaml
checks:
  - name: terminal_artifacts_are_mutually_exclusive
    type: exec-script-exit-zero
    params:
      timeout_seconds: 30
      script: |
        count=0
        test -f docs/example_explore7/ship_report.md && count=$((count + 1))
        test -f docs/example_explore7/ceiling_report.md && count=$((count + 1))
        test -f docs/example_explore7/escalation_note.md && count=$((count + 1))
        test "$count" -le 1
  - name: round_result_and_no_candidate_are_mutually_exclusive
    type: exec-script-exit-zero
    params:
      timeout_seconds: 30
      script: |
        count=0
        test -f docs/example_explore7/round_result.json && count=$((count + 1))
        test -f docs/example_explore7/round_result.json.no_candidate.json && count=$((count + 1))
        test "$count" -le 1
  - name: no_candidate_artifact_shape_when_present
    type: exec-script-exit-zero
    params:
      timeout_seconds: 30
      script: |
        if test ! -f docs/example_explore7/round_result.json.no_candidate.json; then
          exit 0
        fi
        node -e '
          const fs = require("fs");
          const p = "docs/example_explore7/round_result.json.no_candidate.json";
          const x = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8"));
          if (typeof x.label !== "string" || x.label.length === 0) process.exit(1);
          if (x.outcome !== "no_candidate") process.exit(1);
          if (typeof x.reason !== "string" || x.reason.length === 0) process.exit(1);
        '
  - name: shipped_result_survives_confirmation
    type: exec-script-exit-zero
    params:
      timeout_seconds: 3600
      script: |
        if test ! -f docs/example_explore7/ship_report.md; then
          exit 0
        fi
        test -f docs/example_explore7/round_result.json || exit 1
        python3 -m example.research_confirm --result docs/example_explore7/round_result.json
```

# example Explore 7 Ceiling Report

Terminal outcome: `ceiling_hit`.

The mechanically settled research decision is `stop_ceiling`, recorded in `/workspace/.fc/runs/example-run-00000000000001/research_decision.json`. The configured stopping condition that fired was `halt_after_no_improvement: 4`; the recorded count is `consecutiveNoImprovement: 4`, with reason `4 consecutive rounds without improvement`.

The terminal decision rests on the last counted round audit and the scheduler decision derived from the run manifest.

The passed Round 4 audit verdict path is `/workspace/.fc/runs/example-run-00000000000001/verdict_audit_round_04.json`. That verdict records `pass: true`, `outcome: continue`, and a direct audit CLI replay that recomputed preserved raw paired blocks. Before writing this terminal artifact, I re-read `/workspace/.fc/runs/example-run-00000000000001/reality_checks.md` and ran every declared check directly from the project root.

- `terminal artifact exclusivity`: exit `0`.

No machine-readable reality-check declaration needed repair. The terminal exclusivity check was therefore valid before this write, when no terminal artifact existed, and this report is the one terminal artifact selected by the settled `ceiling_hit` decision.

## Project Checks

## Ceiling
